overview_description.description:
Trackin provides delivery software that helps restaurants and delivery companies to remove the pain and frustration to manage deliveries. It gives you full control of your deliveries by connecting managers, drivers, and customers. The dashboard centralizes all your orders, including on third-party websites.

Trackin was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
